text: Dcm321: If the request length is correct, the DSP submodule shall check if the requested subfunction value (access type) is configured in the ECU (see configuration parameter DcmDspSecurityLevel). If the requested subfunction value is not configured, the DSP submodule shall trigger a negative response with NRC 0x12 (SubFunction not supported). | Dcm323: If the requested subfunction value is configured and a service with subfunction type request seed (= odd value) has been received and if the requested access type is already active (see Dcm_GetSecurityLevel()), the DSP submodule shall set the seed content to 0x00. | Dcm324: In the other case than the one described in Dcm323 (access type is not active or “send key” request), the DSP submodule shall call the configured operation Xxx_GetSeed() (in case “request seed” is received) or Xxx_CompareKey() (in case “send key” is received). | class UDS Service 0x27 | «module» | Dcm | «interface» | SecurityAccess_<LEVEL> | CompareKey(return :Std_ReturnType, Key :uint8*) GetSeed(return :Std_ReturnType, SecurityAccessRecord :uint8*, Seed :uint8*, ErrorCode :Dcm_NegativeResponseCodeType*) | «configurable»
